IV. विदेश सेवा पर गया कर्मचारी मूल विभाग में अपना धारणाधिकार बनाए रखता है।

questions.question_english: Review these statements regarding Foreign Service under FR 110-127: I. A government servant cannot be transferred to foreign service against their will. II. While on foreign service, the government servant remains subject to the disciplinary rules of the borrowing organization exclusively. III. Leave salary and pension contributions must be paid to the government by either the foreign employer or the government servant. IV. questions.explanation_english: Transfer to foreign service requires the consent of the government servant. While on foreign service, the employee retains a lien on their parent cadre post, and leave salary and pension contributions are payable to government. Disciplinary control remains with the parent department, although the borrowing organization can initiate preliminary inquiry proceedings

questions.question_hindi:

कारण (R): FR 9(13) के अनुसार, धारणाधिकार किसी स्थायी पद को मौलिक रूप से धारण करने का अधिकार है, जो दूसरे स्थायी पद पर पुष्टि होने पर समाप्त हो जाता है।

A सत्य है, लेकिन R असत्य है
A असत्य है, लेकिन R सत्य है
questions.question_english: Consider the following Assertion (A) and Reason (R). Assertion (A): A government servant who is appointed to a new post on a regular basis cannot retain a lien on their previous post permanently. Reason (R): Under FR 9(13), a lien represents the title of a government servant to hold substantively a permanent post, which ceases once they are confirmed in another permanent post.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true.
questions.explanation_english: A permanent government servant holds a lien on a post, which represents the legal title to hold substantively a permanent post under Fundamental Rule 9(13). When appointed and confirmed in another permanent post, the employee acquires a new lien, causing the previous lien to terminate automatically to avoid dual permanent holdings
questions.explanation_hindi: धारणाधिकार किसी स्थायी पद को मौलिक रूप से धारण करने का अधिकार है। कर्मचारी की दूसरे स्थायी पद पर पुष्टि होने पर पुराने पद पर धारणाधिकार सामान्यतः समाप्त हो जाता है।

questions.question_english: If the leave salary and pension contributions are not paid by the foreign employer on behalf of the government servant on foreign service within the stipulated time, what consequence follows under the rules?
options_english: The government servant is immediately repatriated
Penal interest is charged on the arrears of contribution
The government servant loses their seniority in the parent department
The lien in the parent department is automatically terminated
questions.explanation_english: If leave salary and pension contributions payable for a government servant on foreign service are not remitted within the stipulated period, penal interest is levied on the delayed amount. The penal interest is charged until the full contribution arrears are credited to government account, as prescribed in Fundamental Rules
questions.explanation_hindi: विदेश सेवा में देय अवकाश वेतन और पेंशन अंशदान समय पर जमा करना आवश्यक होता है। भुगतान न होने पर नियमों के अनुसार संबंधित राशि की वसूली या अन्य प्रशासनिक कार्रवाई की जा सकती है।
key_facts: Answer key: (B)
Correct option: Penal interest is charged on the arrears of contribution
